info.name: IT Topology Graph Service - Blast Radius Suite
info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the IT Topology Graph Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032). Builds a real web -> app -> db graph under /it-topology-graph/v1 (Node and Edge initiate, update, control/retire|reactivate, audit-log) and asserts the exact $graphLookup blast radius for DOWNSTREAM, UPSTREAM and BOTH, the maxHops limit and RETIRED-edge exclusion, plus RFC 7807 error_code assertions (400/404/409) and W3C traceparent correlation. Requires an organisationId environment variable populated from the Party Reference Data Directory Service Domain.

exec: // Automatically generate standard W3C traceparent (ADR-010) and X-Trace-Id
pm.test('Liveness status is UP or UNKNOWN (no probe contributors registered)', () => pm.expect(['UP', 'UNKNOWN']).to.include(pm.response.json().status));
